bullets.text: Under supervision, wrote Python functions to parse provided product review records and used unittest to test transformations on hand-checked input examples.

Under supervision, compared a TF-IDF classifier with a majority-label reference on held-out review groups using scikit-learn; checked near-duplicate overlap and examined label-specific errors across repeated splits.

Under supervision, joined review document identifiers to product metadata using pandas merges, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons with Matplotlib, and documented missing-data handling.
As a supervised research team contributor, wrote Python functions to parse provided company report records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.

Under supervision, used regular-expression and dictionary rules with Python re to extract organization and date spans from company report excerpts, then compared extracted spans with provided manually checked examples.

Under supervision, joined report document identifiers to section and reporting-period metadata using pandas merges, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons with Matplotlib, and documented missing-data handling.
As a supervised research team contributor, implemented reusable Python modules for the programming question workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, compared a TF-IDF classifier with a majority-label reference on held-out programming question groups using scikit-learn; checked near-duplicate overlap and examined label-specific errors across repeated splits.

Under supervision, joined programming question document identifiers to post metadata using pandas merges, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons with Matplotlib, and documented missing-data handling.
